hdepic_P01-20240202-161948_0055835_A/hde.caption: A first-person, fisheye lens captures a person in a kitchen. The person, wearing a red and white striped sweater, reaches into an open upper cabinet and takes out a stack of white plates. The audio consists of a series of distinct, ambient kitchen sounds. It begins with the light, clattering sound of ceramic plates being handled and placed on a wooden surface. They place the plates on the wooden countertop below, which is cluttered with various cooking items, including a pot on the stove, a bowl, and a knife block. The person then closes the cabinet door. The camera pans across the kitchen, showing a stove with two pans on it, a white tiled backsplash, and a stainless steel range hood. The person then opens another cabinet, this one filled with spices and jars, and takes out a small container before closing it and placing it back on the shelf. The camera pans back to the stove, where the person uses a wooden spoon to stir the contents of one of the pans. The gentle, rhythmic sound of a wooden spoon stirring liquid in a metal pot can be heard, creating a soft, sloshing noise that continues for the remainder of the clip. The kitchen is dimly lit, with a window visible in the background. There is no speech or narration in the audio.

hdepic_P01-20240203-135502_0126913_AVBea.caption: A first-person, fisheye lens captures a view of a kitchen. The camera pans from a cluttered countertop with a coffee machine and a frying pan on the stove towards a white refrigerator covered in numerous colorful magnets and photos. A person's hand reaches out and opens the refrigerator door. The camera moves closer as the door opens, revealing a well-lit interior filled with food items on the shelves. The person's hand, holding a white paper cup, reaches into the fridge and takes out a container of what appears to be cream or yogurt. The camera pans away from the open refrigerator, showing more of the kitchen, including dark green upper cabinets and a tiled backsplash. The person places the container of cream on the wooden countertop next to the stove. The person opens a drawer below the counter and retrieves a spoon. The camera focuses on the countertop as the person scoops some of the cream from the container and adds it to the paper cup, which already contains a dark, possibly coffee-based, liquid. The person then closes the container and moves it out of the frame. The audio consists entirely of ambient kitchen sounds, creating a quiet and domestic atmosphere. It begins with the soft, metallic click of a refrigerator door opening, followed by the gentle thud of it closing. The primary sounds that follow are the distinct, scraping noise of a drawer being pulled open, and the subsequent light clatter of a spoon scooping a thick, creamy substance from a container. These sounds are clear and close, suggesting the recording is being made from the perspective of the person performing the actions. There is no background music or spoken dialogue.

hdepic_P01-20240203-161757_0002577_TCR/h.caption: A first-person, fisheye lens captures a dark, dimly lit kitchen at night. The camera pans slowly from a cluttered countertop on the left, past a refrigerator on the right, towards an open doorway in the background that reveals a brighter room with a window. The audio consists of a series of quiet, ambient sounds from a kitchen at night. It begins with the soft, creaking sound of a refrigerator door opening. The camera moves closer to the refrigerator, which is covered in photos and magnets. A hand reaches out and opens the refrigerator door, illuminating the interior with its bright light. The hand then selects a foil-wrapped item from a lower shelf and takes it out. The hand closes the refrigerator door, and the camera pans across the kitchen, showing a cluttered countertop with various items like a toaster, a coffee maker, and food containers. The hand places the foil-wrapped item on the counter. The hand then opens a drawer, retrieves a knife, and begins to unwrap the foil. The distinct, crinkling rustle of aluminum foil is heard as it's unwrapped. The person carefully unwraps the item, revealing a dark, flat object inside. The camera remains in a shaky, first-person perspective, focused on the hands and the unwrapped object on the counter. The sequence concludes with the soft, scraping sound of a knife slicing through the foil. Finally, the camera pans away from the counter, showing more of the dimly lit kitchen, including a stove and a tiled backsplash, before the video ends. There is no speech or narration in the audio.

hdepic_P02-20240211-104948_0016671_A/hde.caption: A first-person, fisheye lens captures a view into a kitchen. The camera looks up at a white, built-in pantry shelf filled with various food items, including boxes and jars. A person's arm, clad in a dark long-sleeved shirt, reaches into the frame and takes a red and blue can from the top shelf. The person then takes an orange box from the same shelf. The camera pans down, revealing a kitchen counter with a toaster and a gas stovetop. The person places the items on the counter and then opens a drawer, taking out a spoon and a fork. The camera pans across the kitchen, showing a dining area in the background with a table and chairs. The person then opens another drawer, takes out a plastic bag, and places the utensils on the counter. The camera moves back towards the pantry, and the person closes the drawer. The person then closes the pantry door, which has a brass-colored handle. The camera pans around the kitchen, showing a cluttered space with a red floor and various items on shelves and counters. The person then moves towards a different, more open area of the kitchen, revealing more storage and a window. The audio consists entirely of ambient sounds from a kitchen environment. It begins with the soft rustling and clattering of items being moved and placed on a surface. The sounds include the light thud of boxes and containers being set down. This is followed by the distinct, smooth glide of a drawer opening and closing. The person's hand is seen briefly as they move around the space. The sequence concludes with the sound of a door opening and closing, marked by a slight creak and the click of a latch. There is no speech or music in the audio.

hdepic_P02-20240211-115653_0014425_AVBea.caption: A first-person, fisheye lens captures a person's hands at a white table. The person, wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt and a watch, holds a red and white package of grated parmesan cheese in their left hand. With their right hand, they use a pair of blue-handled scissors to cut open the top of the package. The background, visible through the distorted lens, shows a dining area with a table and chairs, and a sliding glass door leading outside. The table is covered with various food items and containers. The camera remains stationary, providing a top-down perspective of the action. The audio consists of a series of distinct, close-up sound effects. It begins with the sharp, rhythmic snipping of scissors cutting through a plastic package. The person finishes cutting the package and places the scissors down on the table. They then use both hands to tear open the top of the package. This is followed by the crinkling and tearing of the plastic as the package is opened. After opening it, they pour the grated cheese from the package onto a long, flat sheet of dough that is laid out on the table. The camera angle remains a steady, top-down fisheye view, showing the cheese being sprinkled across the dough. The sequence concludes with the soft, rustling sound of a granular substance, like grated cheese, being poured from the package onto a flat surface. There is no speech or background music.
